"""Assemble a source-grounded phase plan without invented assignments or dates."""
import hashlib
import re
from datetime import date, timedelta
from time import perf_counter

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import HandleInput, Output
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class MiraPlanner(Component):
    """Compose a phase plan from cited description paragraphs and scheduled phases."""

    display_name = "Mira Planner"
    description = "Builds a source-grounded phase plan from validated context and timeline."
    icon = "list-checks"
    name = "MiraPlanner"
    inputs = [
        HandleInput(name="request_message", display_name="User Request", input_types=["Message"], required=True),
        HandleInput(name="context_data", display_name="Validated Context", input_types=["Data"], required=True),
        HandleInput(name="timeline_data", display_name="Scheduled Timeline", input_types=["Data"], required=True),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Project Plan", name="project_plan", method="build_plan")]

    @staticmethod
    def _day(value: object) -> date:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}", value):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Expected an ISO calendar date.")
        try:
            return date.fromisoformat(value)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Invalid calendar date.") from exc

    def _validate(self) -> tuple[dict, list[dict], date]:
        """Verify date provenance and source deliverables before selecting phases."""
        if not isinstance(self.timeline_data, Data):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_TIMELINE: Connect the Timeline Adapter output.")
        data = self.timeline_data.data
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or data.get("schema_version") != "1.0":
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Expected schema version 1.0.")
        if data.get("project_id") != "abcde_ai_adoption" or data.get("timezone") != "Asia/Kolkata":
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Unexpected project or timezone.")
        schedule = data.get("schedule_config")
        if not isinstance(schedule, dict) or schedule.get("mode") not in ("demo", "original"):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Invalid schedule configuration.")
        if (schedule.get("timeline_week_policy") != "seven_day_periods_from_start"
                or schedule.get("milestone_deadline_policy") != "unknown"):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Unsupported schedule policy.")
        reporting = self._day(data.get("reporting_date"))
        if schedule.get("reporting_date") != reporting.isoformat():
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Inconsistent reporting dates.")
        demo = schedule["mode"] == "demo"
        anchor_value = schedule.get("demo_project_start_date" if demo else "actual_project_start_date")
        if demo and anchor_value is None:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Demo start is required.")
        anchor = self._day(anchor_value) if anchor_value is not None else None
        expected_basis = "demo_phase_windows" if demo else "actual_start_phase_windows" if anchor else "relative_weeks_only"
        if (data.get("date_basis") != expected_basis
                or data.get("calendar_anchor_date") != anchor_value
                or data.get("calendar_dates_available") is not (anchor is not None)):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Inconsistent calendar basis.")
        phases = data.get("phases")
        if not isinstance(phases, list) or not phases or len(phases) > 1000:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_TIMELINE: Expected between 1 and 1000 phases.")
        previous_end = 0
        for expected_id, phase in enumerate(phases, start=1):
            if not isinstance(phase, dict):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Invalid phase record.")
            start_week, end_week = phase.get("start_week"), phase.get("end_week")
            if (type(phase.get("phase")) is not int or phase["phase"] != expected_id
                    or type(start_week) is not int or type(end_week) is not int
                    or start_week != previous_end + 1 or not start_week <= end_week <= 9999):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Invalid phase ID or week interval.")
            previous_end = end_week
            source = phase.get("source_row")
            if (not isinstance(source, dict) or source.get("phase") != str(expected_id)
                    or source.get("start_week") != str(start_week) or source.get("end_week") != str(end_week)
                    or not isinstance(source.get("phase_name"), str) or not source["phase_name"].strip()
                    or source["phase_name"] != phase.get("phase_name")
                    or not isinstance(source.get("milestones_deliverables"), str)):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Phase disagrees with preserved source.")
            names = [name.strip() for name in source["milestones_deliverables"].split(";")]
            expected_milestones = [{"name": name, "deadline": None, "completion_status": "unknown",
                                    "risk_status": "unknown"} for name in names]
            if not all(names) or phase.get("milestones") != expected_milestones or phase.get("actual_progress") != "unknown":
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Unsupported milestone dates, progress or source names.")
            try:
                start = anchor + timedelta(days=(start_week - 1) * 7) if anchor else None
                end = anchor + timedelta(days=end_week * 7 - 1) if anchor else None
            except OverflowError as exc:
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Phase dates exceed supported calendar range.") from exc
            if (phase.get("planned_start_date") != (start.isoformat() if start else None)
                    or phase.get("planned_end_date") != (end.isoformat() if end else None)):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Phase dates disagree with configured start.")
        if data.get("total_phases") != len(phases) or data.get("total_weeks") != previous_end:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Inconsistent timeline totals.")
        return data, phases, reporting

    @staticmethod
    def _safe(text: str) -> str:
        """Display source text as escaped Markdown, never as executable instructions."""
        return re.sub(r"([\\`*_{}\[\]()<>#!|])", r"\\\1", " ".join(text.split()))

    @staticmethod
    def _supported_request(text: str) -> bool:
        query = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.strip().lower()).rstrip(".?!")
        query = re.sub(r"^please ", "", query)
        query = re.sub(r"\. use the provided project description$", " use the provided project description", query)
        pattern = (r"(?:generate|create|build|show)(?: a| the)? (?:structured |high-level )?"
                   r"(?:ai adoption )?(?:project )?plan for "
                   r"(?:abcde ltd|the ai adoption project at abcde ltd)"
                   r"(?: use the provided project description)?")
        return re.fullmatch(pattern, query) is not None

    def _context(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Recheck paragraph identities and the source hash before citing context."""
        if not isinstance(self.context_data, Data):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_CONTEXT: Connect Project Context Validator Validated Context.")
        context = self.context_data.data
        if (not isinstance(context, dict) or context.get("schema_version") != "1.0"
                or context.get("project_id") != "abcde_ai_adoption"
                or context.get("context_kind") != "source_description"
                or context.get("validation_scope") != "document_structure_only"):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_CONTEXT: Unexpected project context contract.")
        raw = context.get("source_text")
        source_ref = context.get("source")
        if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip() or not isinstance(source_ref, dict):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_CONTEXT: Source description or provenance is missing.")
        try:
            encoded = raw.encode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeEncodeError as exc:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_CONTEXT: Invalid Unicode description.") from exc
        if len(encoded) > 100_000 or any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\r\n\t" for c in raw):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_CONTEXT: Invalid description size or control characters.")
        if (source_ref.get("file") != "project_description.txt"
                or source_ref.get("sha256_loaded_text") != hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_CONTEXT: Source provenance disagrees with loaded text.")
        normalized = raw.lstrip("\ufeff").replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").strip()
        title, separator, body = normalized.partition("\n")
        if (title.strip() != "AI Adoption Project Description for ABCDE Ltd."
                or context.get("title") != title.strip() or not separator or not body.strip()):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_CONTEXT: Unexpected description title or missing body.")
        paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"\n[ \t]*\n", body.strip()) if p.strip()]
        expected = [{"paragraph_id": f"P{i:03d}", "text": p,
                     "source_ref": {"file": "project_description.txt", "body_paragraph_number": i}}
                    for i, p in enumerate(paragraphs, start=1)]
        if (len(expected) > 100 or context.get("paragraphs") != expected
                or type(context.get("paragraph_count")) is not int or context["paragraph_count"] != len(expected)):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_CONTEXT: Paragraph references disagree with preserved description.")
        return expected

    def _plan_timeline(self) -> tuple[dict, list[dict], date]:
        """Validate planned windows plus the activities needed by this Planner."""
        timeline, phases, reporting = self._validate()
        for phase in phases:
            raw_activities = phase["source_row"].get("key_activities")
            if not isinstance(raw_activities, str):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Missing source activities.")
            activities = [part.strip() for part in raw_activities.split(";")]
            if not all(activities) or phase.get("key_activities") != activities:
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Activities disagree with source.")
            if phase.get("source_ref") != {"file": "project_timeline.csv", "phase": str(phase["phase"]), "record_number": phase["phase"]}:
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_TIMELINE: Invalid phase source reference.")
        return timeline, phases, reporting

    def build_plan(self) -> Message:
        """Return the supported phase plan or clarify unsupported project constraints."""
        started = perf_counter()
        request = self.request_message
        if not isinstance(request, Message) or not isinstance(request.text, str) or not request.text.strip():
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_REQUEST: Connect dispatcher PLAN to User Request.")
        supported = self._supported_request(request.text)
        if not supported:
            text = ("This component can structure the supplied ABCDE AI adoption plan. "
                    "For that plan, ask: Generate a project plan for ABCDE Ltd. "
                    "For a new project or a changed schedule, please specify the objective, scope, deliverables, "
                    "timeline constraints and available resources, and provide the supporting project data. "
                    "I cannot infer those details or silently change the supplied plan.")
        elif not isinstance(self.context_data, Data) or not isinstance(self.timeline_data, Data):
            text = ("Please provide both the project description and project timeline through the validated inputs. "
                    "I cannot build a grounded phase plan without them.")
        else:
            paragraphs = self._context()
            timeline, phases, reporting = self._plan_timeline()
            demo = timeline["schedule_config"]["mode"] == "demo"
            label = "DEMO SCHEDULE" if demo else "SOURCE PHASE PLAN"
            parts = [f"**{label} — ABCDE Ltd. AI Adoption Project Plan**",
                     f"Planning reference date: {reporting.isoformat()} (Asia/Kolkata). "
                     f"The supplied timeline has {len(phases)} phases across {timeline['total_weeks']} weeks.",
                     "This plan organizes the supplied description and timeline. Goals and deliverables are planned intentions, "
                     "not achieved results or verified completion states.",
                     "**Project scope, objectives and approach — source description**"]
            for paragraph in paragraphs:
                parts.append(f"**Source excerpt — project_description.txt [{paragraph['paragraph_id']}]**\n\n"
                             f"> {self._safe(paragraph['text'])}")
            parts.append("**Phase plan**")
            for phase in phases:
                parts.append(f"**Phase {phase['phase']} — {self._safe(phase['phase_name'])}**")
                timing = f"Weeks {phase['start_week']}–{phase['end_week']}."
                if timeline["calendar_dates_available"]:
                    timing += f" Planned phase window: {phase['planned_start_date']} through {phase['planned_end_date']}, inclusive."
                else:
                    timing += " Calendar dates are unknown because the actual project start date is not supplied."
                parts.append(timing)
                parts.append("Activities:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"- {self._safe(activity)}" for activity in phase["key_activities"]))
                parts.append("Planned deliverables:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"- {self._safe(m['name'])}" for m in phase["milestones"]))
                parts.append(f"Source: project_timeline.csv, phase {phase['phase']}. "
                             "Individual milestone deadlines, named phase owners and actual progress are not established by these inputs.")
            if demo:
                parts.append(f"**Date basis:** Simulated phase dates use demo_project_start_date "
                             f"{timeline['calendar_anchor_date']} in mira_config.json. These are not confirmed project dates.")
            elif not timeline["calendar_dates_available"]:
                parts.append("**Date clarification:** What is the confirmed actual project start date? "
                             "Until it is provided, retain the source week ranges without calendar commitments.")
            else:
                parts.append(f"**Date basis:** Planned windows use actual_project_start_date "
                             f"{timeline['calendar_anchor_date']} from mira_config.json; this does not establish actual phase progress.")
            parts.append("**Items requiring confirmation before execution**\n\n"
                         "- Named phase owners, resource allocations and an approved budget.\n"
                         "- Individual milestone deadlines and acceptance criteria.\n"
                         "- Baseline measurements and measurement methods for the stated targets.\n"
                         "- Task-to-phase dependencies and sprint-to-phase mapping.\n\n"
                         "Please supply the missing details if you need an assigned, budgeted or committed execution plan. "
                         "These inputs do not establish them, and phase end dates are not individual milestone deadlines.")
            text = "\n\n".join(parts)
        elapsed = (perf_counter() - started) * 1000
        self.status = f"Planner response prepared in {elapsed:.1f} ms"
        self.log(f"mira_planner duration_ms={elapsed:.1f} model_calls=0")
        return Message(text=text, session_id=getattr(request, "session_id", "") or "",
                       sender="Machine", sender_name="Mira Planner")

"""Ask for missing request constraints without inventing project facts."""
import re
from time import perf_counter

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import HandleInput, Output
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class MiraClarificationHandler(Component):
    """Render bounded clarification prompts for the dispatcher's CLARIFY branch."""

    display_name = "Mira Clarification Handler"
    description = "Asks for missing scope or constraints instead of echoing a vague request."
    icon = "circle-help"
    name = "MiraClarificationHandler"
    inputs = [HandleInput(name="request_message", display_name="User Request",
                          input_types=["Message"], required=True)]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Clarification", name="clarification", method="clarify")]

    def clarify(self) -> Message:
        """Return focused questions; retain the session without reusing user identity."""
        started = perf_counter()
        request = self.request_message
        if not isinstance(request, Message) or not isinstance(request.text, str) or not request.text.strip():
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_REQUEST: Connect dispatcher CLARIFY to User Request.")
        if len(request.text) > 20_000:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: Please shorten the request to 20000 characters or fewer.")
        query = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", request.text.casefold()).replace("–", "-").replace("—", "-")
        # These are cues for choosing questions, never factual project assertions.
        cues = {
            "planning": r"\b(plan|planning|roadmap|chatbot)\b",
            "risk": r"\b(risk|risks|assessment|mitigation|mitigations)\b",
            "status": r"\b(status|progress|task|tasks|kanban|sprint)\b",
            "milestones": r"\b(milestone|milestones|deliverable|deliverables)\b",
            "communications": r"\b(email|stakeholder update|stakeholder message)\b",
        }
        kinds = [kind for kind, pattern in cues.items() if re.search(pattern, query)]
        if len(kinds) > 1:
            kind = "multiple_or_ambiguous"
            opening = "I need a clearer primary request before proceeding."
            questions = [
                "Which single output should I produce first: a plan, risk report, status report, milestone outlook, or stakeholder email draft?",
                "Is this for the existing ABCDE AI adoption project or another project?",
                "Please state the scope for that output, such as the sprint, risk ID, reporting period, or planning constraints.",
            ]
        elif kinds == ["planning"]:
            kind = "planning"
            opening = "I need more project details to create a grounded plan."
            questions = [
                "Is this part of the ABCDE AI adoption project or a separate project? What outcome and scope should the plan cover?",
                "Who will use the solution, what must it deliver, and how will success be measured?",
            ]
            if re.search(r"\b(?:2|two)[ -]+weeks?\b", query):
                questions.append("You mentioned two weeks. Is that the intended project duration, and what team capacity and dependencies must the plan respect?")
            else:
                questions.append("What timeline constraints, team capacity and dependencies must the plan respect?")
            if re.search(r"\bchatbot\b", query):
                questions[1] = "Who will use the chatbot, which tasks and channels must it support, and what approved information sources may it use?"
                questions.append("What acceptance criteria will determine whether the chatbot succeeds?")
        elif kinds == ["risk"]:
            kind = "risk"
            opening = "I need the project scope and evidence before assessing risks."
            questions = [
                "Is this for the existing ABCDE risk register or a new project?",
                "For a new project, what are its objectives, systems, data, integrations and delivery constraints? Please provide the supporting description or risk records.",
                "Do you need an unranked register or a scored assessment? Scoring requires an approved likelihood/impact scale and evidence-based ratings.",
            ]
        elif kinds == ["status"]:
            kind = "status"
            opening = "A general statement about progress is not enough to calculate task status."
            questions = [
                "Which sprint or whole-project scope should I summarize?",
                "Should I use the supplied ABCDE task-board snapshot, or do you have an updated board? A narrative statement alone cannot establish task counts or completed work.",
                "Should I use the configured reporting date, or a different explicitly stated date? Claims about changes over time require a dated earlier snapshot or task history.",
            ]
        elif kinds == ["milestones"]:
            kind = "milestones"
            opening = "Please specify the milestone outlook you need."
            questions = [
                "Is this for the ABCDE AI adoption timeline?",
                "How many days or weeks after the configured reporting date should the outlook cover?",
                "Do you need planned phase deliverables or confirmed milestone deadlines? The supplied timeline has phase week ranges, but no individual milestone deadlines.",
            ]
        elif kinds == ["communications"]:
            kind = "communications"
            opening = "I need the scope and evidence for the stakeholder update."
            questions = [
                "Which project, sprint and reporting period should the draft cover?",
                "Who is the intended audience, and which source snapshot or approved facts should the draft use?",
                "Are you requesting a draft? This clarification component does not send email.",
            ]
        else:
            kind = "general"
            opening = "I need a more specific project request."
            questions = [
                "Which output do you need: a plan, risk report, status report, milestone outlook, or stakeholder email draft?",
                "Is this for the ABCDE AI adoption project or another project?",
                "What scope, time period and supporting data should I use?",
            ]
        text = "\n\n".join([
            "**Clarification needed**", opening,
            "\n".join(f"{index}. {question}" for index, question in enumerate(questions, start=1)),
            "Please include these details in a complete new request so it can be routed correctly.",
        ])
        elapsed = (perf_counter() - started) * 1000
        self.status = f"Clarification prepared: {kind}"
        self.log(f"mira_clarification_handler kind={kind} duration_ms={elapsed:.1f} model_calls=0")
        return Message(text=text, session_id=getattr(request, "session_id", "") or "",
                       sender="Machine", sender_name="Mira Clarification Handler")

"""Draft a stakeholder snapshot email from scheduled task facts; never send it."""
import re
from collections import Counter
from datetime import date, timedelta
from time import perf_counter

from lfx.custom.custom_component.component import Component
from lfx.io import HandleInput, Output
from lfx.schema.data import Data
from lfx.schema.message import Message


class MiraStakeholderEmailDrafter(Component):
    """Build a reviewable draft without recipient selection or delivery tools."""

    display_name = "Mira Stakeholder Email Drafter"
    description = "Drafts a source-grounded sprint update; does not send email."
    icon = "mail"
    name = "MiraStakeholderEmailDrafter"
    inputs = [
        HandleInput(name="request_message", display_name="User Request", input_types=["Message"], required=True),
        HandleInput(name="scheduled_data", display_name="Scheduled Board", input_types=["Data"], required=True),
    ]
    outputs = [Output(display_name="Email Draft", name="email_draft", method="draft")]
    STATES = ("Done", "In Progress", "To Do", "Blocked")

    @staticmethod
    def _day(value: object) -> date:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", value):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Expected ISO calendar date.")
        return date.fromisoformat(value)

    def _validate(self) -> tuple[dict, list[dict], date]:
        """Check required facts and recompute dates rather than trusting aggregates."""
        if not isinstance(self.scheduled_data, Data):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_BOARD: Connect the Schedule Adapter.")
        board = self.scheduled_data.data
        if not isinstance(board, dict) or board.get("schema_version") != "1.0":
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Unsupported board schema.")
        if board.get("project_id") != "abcde_ai_adoption" or board.get("timezone") != "Asia/Kolkata":
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Unexpected project or timezone.")
        basis = board.get("date_basis")
        if basis not in {"demo_adjusted", "original_source_dates"}:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Unknown date basis.")
        shift = board.get("date_shift_days")
        if type(shift) is not int or (basis == "original_source_dates" and shift != 0):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Invalid date shift.")
        reporting = self._day(board.get("reporting_date"))
        tasks = board.get("tasks")
        if not isinstance(tasks, list) or not tasks:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_BOARD: No task records available.")
        seen = set()
        for task in tasks:
            fields = ("task_id", "task_name", "status", "sprint", "assignee", "description")
            if not isinstance(task, dict) or any(not isinstance(task.get(k), str) or not task[k].strip() for k in fields):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Missing task facts.")
            if not re.fullmatch(r"T[0-9]{3}", task["task_id"]) or task["task_id"] in seen:
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Invalid or duplicate task ID.")
            seen.add(task["task_id"])
            if task["status"] not in self.STATES or not re.fullmatch(r"Sprint [1-9][0-9]*", task["sprint"]):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Invalid status or sprint.")
            original = self._day(task.get("due_date"))
            effective = self._day(task.get("effective_due_date"))
            if effective != original + timedelta(days=shift):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Effective deadline disagrees with date shift.")
        return board, tasks, reporting

    @staticmethod
    def _safe(text: str) -> str:
        """Escape Markdown control characters in source text displayed as facts."""
        return re.sub(r"([\\`*_{}\[\]()<>#!|])", r"\\\1", " ".join(text.split()))

    @staticmethod
    def _sprint(text: str) -> str | None:
        """Recognize an explicit single-sprint draft request with no added instructions."""
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text.strip().lower()).rstrip(".?!")
        text = re.sub(r"^please ", "", text)
        pattern = (r"(?:draft|generate|create|write) (?:a |an )?(?:stakeholder )?update email "
                   r"(?:for|summarizing|summarising) (sprint [1-9][0-9]*)(?: progress| status)?")
        match = re.fullmatch(pattern, text)
        return match.group(1).title() if match else None

    def _checked_board(self) -> tuple[dict, list[dict], date]:
        """Check original source records as well as effective task deadlines."""
        board, tasks, reporting = self._validate()
        schedule = board.get("schedule_config")
        if not isinstance(schedule, dict) or schedule.get("reporting_date") != reporting.isoformat():
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Reporting date disagrees with configuration.")
        mode = schedule.get("mode")
        if mode not in ("demo", "original") or (mode == "demo") != (board["date_basis"] == "demo_adjusted"):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Inconsistent schedule mode.")
        if mode == "demo":
            reference = self._day(schedule.get("original_reference_start_date"))
            demo = self._day(schedule.get("demo_project_start_date"))
            if (demo - reference).days != board["date_shift_days"]:
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Date shift disagrees with configured starts.")
        source = board.get("source_board")
        if not isinstance(source, dict) or not isinstance(source.get("tasks"), list):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Preserved source board is missing.")
        original_tasks = source["tasks"]
        if len(original_tasks) != len(tasks):
            raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Source and scheduled task counts differ.")
        fields = ("task_id", "task_name", "status", "assignee", "priority", "sprint", "due_date", "labels", "description")
        for original, task in zip(original_tasks, tasks):
            if (not isinstance(original, dict) or set(original) != set(fields)
                    or any(not isinstance(original[field], str) or task.get(field) != original[field] for field in fields)):
                raise ValueError("MIRA_INVALID_BOARD: Scheduled task disagrees with preserved source.")
        return board, tasks, reporting

    def draft(self) -> Message:
        """Return a draft or clarification in a fresh Message; no delivery side effects."""
        started = perf_counter()
        request = self.request_message
        if not isinstance(request, Message) or not isinstance(request.text, str) or not request.text.strip():
            raise ValueError("MIRA_MISSING_REQUEST: Connect dispatcher COMMS to User Request.")
        if len(request.text) > 20_000:
            raise ValueError("MIRA_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE: Please shorten the request to 20000 characters or fewer.")
        sprint = self._sprint(request.text)
        if sprint is None:
            text = ("Please request a draft for one explicit sprint, for example: "
                    "Draft a stakeholder update email summarizing Sprint 2 progress. "
                    "This component does not send email. Recipient selection, custom date periods, "
                    "additional instructions and historical change reports require separate handling.")
        elif not isinstance(self.scheduled_data, Data):
            text = "Please provide the validated scheduled task board before I draft a factual stakeholder update."
        else:
            board, tasks, reporting = self._checked_board()
            selected = [task for task in tasks if task["sprint"] == sprint]
            if not selected:
                available = sorted({t["sprint"] for t in tasks}, key=lambda s: int(s.split()[1]))
                text = f"No source tasks were found for {sprint}. Available sprints: {', '.join(available)}. Which should I use?"
            else:
                counts = Counter(task["status"] for task in selected)
                overdue = [t for t in selected if t["status"] != "Done" and self._day(t["effective_due_date"]) < reporting]
                due_today = [t["task_id"] for t in selected if t["status"] != "Done" and self._day(t["effective_due_date"]) == reporting]
                blockers_elsewhere = [t for t in tasks if t["status"] == "Blocked" and t["sprint"] != sprint]
                demo = board["date_basis"] == "demo_adjusted"
                label = "DEMO SCHEDULE" if demo else "ORIGINAL SOURCE SNAPSHOT"
                subject = f"ABCDE AI Adoption — {sprint} snapshot — {reporting.isoformat()}"
                if demo:
                    subject = "[DEMO] " + subject
                parts = [f"**EMAIL DRAFT — {label} — NOT SENT**",
                         f"**Subject:** {subject}", "Hello,",
                         f"Here is the {sprint} task-board snapshot for the ABCDE AI adoption project, "
                         f"evaluated against reporting date {reporting.isoformat()} (Asia/Kolkata). "
                         "Statuses reflect the supplied board, not verified live progress.",
                         f"**Sprint summary:** {len(selected)} tasks; " + "; ".join(f"{state}: {counts[state]}" for state in self.STATES) + ". "
                         f"Task completion: {counts['Done']}/{len(selected)} ({100 * counts['Done'] / len(selected):.1f}%). "
                         "This is task-count completion, not effort completion.",
                         "**Task details**"]
                parts.append("\n".join(
                    f"- {t['task_id']} — {self._safe(t['task_name'])}: {t['status']}; "
                    f"assignee: {self._safe(t['assignee'])}; effective due: {t['effective_due_date']}; source due: {t['due_date']}."
                    for t in selected))
                parts.append("**Overdue unfinished tasks in this sprint:** " + (", ".join(t["task_id"] for t in overdue) or "None") + ".")
                parts.append("**Unfinished tasks due on the reporting date:** " + (", ".join(due_today) or "None") + ".")
                if blockers_elsewhere:
                    parts.append("**Project-wide blockers outside this sprint — excluded from the sprint counts**")
                    parts.append("\n".join(
                        f"- {t['task_id']} ({t['sprint']}) — {self._safe(t['task_name'])}; assignee: {self._safe(t['assignee'])}; "
                        f"effective due: {t['effective_due_date']}. Source description: {self._safe(t['description'])}."
                        for t in blockers_elsewhere))
                parts.append("**Evidence limits:** This snapshot does not establish which tasks were completed during a particular week. "
                             "No task-to-milestone dependency mapping is supplied, so milestone impact is unknown.")
                parts.append("**Sources:** sample_task_board.csv (task IDs shown above); mira_config.json (reporting date and date policy).")
                if demo:
                    parts.append(f"**Demo date basis:** Task deadlines use a {board['date_shift_days']}-day shift. "
                                 "These are simulated dates; source deadlines, task statuses and sprint assignments are preserved.")
                parts.extend(["Regards,\nMira Project Intelligence Assistant",
                              "**Review before sending:** No recipients have been selected, and no email has been sent."])
                text = "\n\n".join(parts)
        elapsed = (perf_counter() - started) * 1000
        self.status = "Email draft or clarification prepared; no email sent"
        self.log(f"mira_email_drafter duration_ms={elapsed:.1f} model_calls=0 emails_sent=0")
        return Message(text=text, session_id=getattr(request, "session_id", "") or "",
                       sender="Machine", sender_name="Mira Stakeholder Email Drafter")
